description.value: Bows Coffee Roasters is a small family-run roastery and cafe in Victoria, BC that sources directly from named producers across Guatemala and Colombia, roasting on-site at the Garbally Road location. The business emphasizes long-term producer relationships and ethical sourcing within the specialty coffee trade. A sister cafe called Torch Song on Government Street is operated by the same team.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is a real, active roastery cafe at 483 Garbally Rd, Victoria, BC — matching OSM address and phone exactly; the locations page names it 'Victoria Roastery Cafe' with weekday hours, and the about page and footer both corroborate the address and phone number. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible roastery cafe with confirmed address, phone, and current website. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking coffee.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM address lacks postal code; website locations page provides full address as V8T 2J9, used here. Torch Song (1812 Government St, torchsong.ca) is a separate sister-business location and may warrant its own OSM/WWC record.

wow_evidence: small family-run roastery... sister cafe called Torch Song on Government Street is operated by the same team
